label: rem:substrate-line-bundle-base-not-fibre
title: The QOU structure is the base, not the fibre
html:
Key property: the QOU structure is the base, not the fibre. The rigid triple (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) paired with the core QOU axioms anchors exclusively to the base of the family. The substrate parameter q acts merely as a coordinate riding on the fibre \mathbb{G}_m.

Consequently:

  • \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) is strictly independent of q.
  • c_1(\mathrm{Ad}(A)) and c_2(\mathrm{Ad}(A)) are strictly independent of q.
  • The Euler class e(\xi) tracking the Reeb bundle is strictly independent of q.

The categorical trace \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_A) is not on this list. It was, until an owner ruling of 2026-09-15 identified it with the quantum dimension \dim_q(A) — the Euler characteristic of an object in the QOU category — which is manifestly q-dependent ([2]_q = q + q^{-1} on the fundamental). The four bullets above are unaffected: each is a class or a hom-space, fixed by (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) alone. What moves is only the trace, and with it the reading of \chi(A) as an invariant of the base rather than a function on the fibre. See the \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_A) entry in the notation register.

The entire architecture of the obstruction tower \{\kappa_n \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B})\} is a fixed property of (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau), not a fluid artefact of the section q.
